```{r, warning = FALSE}
library(readxl)

```


# Multimedia Item Report (IR_M1)


## Load the Usage Database


```{r}
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "C:\\Users\\aharrima\\OneDrive - University of Tennessee\\Documents\\Big_Usage_Database_Updated.db")

IR_M1 <- dbGetQuery(con,
                    'SELECT *
                    FROM IR_M1')

IR_M1
```


# Check Fiscal Year Usage

```{r}
irM1ByFY <- IR_M1 |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Total_Item_Requests') |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0))) |>
  group_by(Vendor) |>
  summarise(fy22 = sum(`Jul-2021` + `Aug-2021` + `Sep-2021` + `Oct-2021` + `Nov-2021` + `Dec-2021` + `Jan-2022` + `Feb-2022` + `Mar-2022` + `Apr-2022` + `May-2022` + `Jun-2022`),
            fy23 = sum(`Jul-2022` + `Aug-2022` + `Sep-2022` + `Oct-2022` + `Nov-2022` + `Dec-2022` + `Jan-2023` + `Feb-2023` + `Mar-2023` + `Apr-2023` + `May-2023` + `Jun-2023`),
            fy24 = sum(`Jul-2023` + `Aug-2023` + `Sep-2023` + `Oct-2023` + `Nov-2023` + `Dec-2023` + `Jan-2024` + `Feb-2024` + `Mar-2024` + `Apr-2024` + `May-2024` + `Jun-2024`),
            fy25 = sum(`Jul-2024` + `Aug-2024` + `Sep-2024` + `Oct-2024` + `Nov-2024` + `Dec-2024` + `Jan-2025` + `Feb-2025` + `Mar-2025` + `Apr-2025` + `May-2025` + `Jun-2025`),
            fy26 = sum(`Jul-2025` + `Aug-2025` + `Sep-2025` + `Oct-2025` + `Nov-2025` + `Dec-2025` + `Jan-2026` + `Feb-2026` + `Mar-2026` + `Apr-2026` + `May-2026` + `Jun-2026`))

irM1ByFY
```



## Check for One-Off Usage Spikes

```{r}
irm1Long <- dbGetQuery(con,
                    "SELECT Vendor
                    , Month
                    , SUM(Usage) as Usage
                    FROM IR_M1_Long
                    WHERE Metric_Type == 'Total_Item_Requests'
                    GROUP BY Vendor, Month")


maxMonths <- irm1Long |>
  filter(Month >= '2024-01-01') |>
  group_by(Vendor) |>
  slice_max(order_by = Usage, n = 7)

maxMonths
```

# TR Cleaning for Python Usage Fixing

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "C:\\Users\\aharrima\\OneDrive - University of Tennessee\\Documents\\Big_Usage_Database_Updated.db")

                    'SELECT *
                    FROM TR_Archive')

trArchive
```



```{r}
trArchiveZeroed <- trArchive |>
  mutate(`Jan-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Jan-2025`),
         `Feb-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Feb-2025`),
         `Mar-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Mar-2025`),
         `Apr-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Apr-2025`),
         `May-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `May-2025`),
         `Jun-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Jun-2025`),
         `Jul-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Jul-2025`),
         `Aug-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Aug-2025`),
         `Sep-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Sep-2025`),
         `Oct-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Oct-2025`),
         `Nov-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Nov-2025`),
         `Dec-2025` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Dec-2025`),
         `Jan-2026` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Jan-2026`),
         `Feb-2026` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Feb-2026`),
         `Mar-2026` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Mar-2026`),
         `Apr-2026` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Apr-2026`),
         `May-2026` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `May-2026`),
         `Jun-2026` = ifelse(Vendor %in% c('Liverpool'), 0, `Jun-2026`)) |>
  select(-c('index', 'Reporting_Period_Total'))

trArchiveZeroed
```


```{r}
dbWriteTable(con, 'TR_Archive', trArchiveZeroed, overwrite = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
```
